standard_prerequisites.name: A bounded above complex of projective modules over the quotient admits a quasi-isomorphism to any representing complex of the derived tensor product
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the map delta from the given complex over R/I to the complex K/IK and thereby the cone on delta.

standard_prerequisites.name: An acyclic bounded above complex whose terms are of the form P/IP for P in the class can be lifted to an acyclic complex with terms in the class
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the acyclic lift A of the cone whose terms lie in the class.

standard_prerequisites.name: A map into a bounded above complex of projectives can be lifted along a quasi-isomorphism, which produces the dotted arrow in the diagram
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the map from K to A making the square commute and hence the comparison of terms.

standard_prerequisites.name: A finite free or projective module over the class is projective, so kernels and cokernels appearing in the split argument are again projective
standard_prerequisites.use: Lets the maps g and the projection be split, producing the complementary summand T.

core_obligations: Represent K by a bounded above complex K with terms in the class, so that K tensor R/I is represented by K/IK, and choose a quasi-isomorphism delta from the given quotient complex E to K/IK using that E is bounded above with projective terms (proof lines 19411-19417).

Form the cone C on delta; its terms are direct sums of terms of K/IK with terms of E shifted, hence are of the form P/IP for P in the class by the closure properties of the class (proof lines 19418-19422).
Apply the acyclic lifting statement to C, which is acyclic, and obtain an acyclic bounded above complex A with terms in the class (proof lines 19422-19425).

Use the lifting property for maps into bounded above complexes of projectives to find the dotted arrow K to A making the diagram commute, and show that each K^i to A^i is the inclusion of a direct summand (proof lines 19426-19440).

Conclude that the cokernel of K to A shifted is a bounded above complex with terms in the class whose quotient by I is E and which represents K, then verify the auxiliary split-injectivity statement: lift P_2 to P_3, split off the kernel P'_1, show the complementary summand T is annihilated by I and conclude T is zero (proof lines 19441-19466).
proof_roadmap: Represent K and choose the quasi-isomorphism to the quotient complex, then build the cone (proof lines 19411-19422).
Lift the acyclic cone to an acyclic complex in the class (proof lines 19422-19425).
Find the dotted arrow and prove its terms are split injections (proof lines 19426-19440).
Take the shifted cokernel as the representing complex, and finish by the split-injectivity lemma that closes the paper (proof lines 19441-19466).
difficulty_reason: statement 是「商环上的复形可提升到一类投射模的有界上方复形」的定量刻画，假设五条（类对直和与直和项的封闭性、模 I 满射即满射、商复形的项形如 P/IP、K 可由类中项表示）。证明是构造性的且相当完整：用商复形的投射性取拟同构，作锥把两个复形缝起来，把锥的项写成 P/IP，用作者自己的「无环复形可提升」引理拿到 A，再用「射到有界上方投射复形的映射可提升」补出虚线箭头；随后必须证明 K 到 A 的各项是直和项嵌入，为此补了一段完整的化简论证（把 P_2 分解为 P'_1 与 P_3，考察投影 P_1 到 P'_1，模 I 是同构，用投射性劈出 T，再用 T/IT=0 与 0 属于类证明 T=0）。承重演算全在 span 内；4 处引用（1 处同章、3 处跨章）均为导航桩。量化宽松、步骤可复核，故 H2。
